text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final day of summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-saaan! There you are! I found the 
black kitty!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Good girl, Kitasan! Hehe, you're getting 
lots and lots of headpats♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait!? I thought you said you were 
gonna pat my head...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You dummy. You're an Umamusume, not a 
cat!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Phew! I petted a black cat and recharged 
my magic power, so preparations for the 
Shuka Sho are absolutely flawless!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
――So regarding your next race, the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), you're "extremely 
confident"...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Autumn Shield is mine for the taking. 
And after that... I shall march straight 
down the Senior Autumn Triple Crown path!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The book has already been opened. Now, 
everyone, please—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward with excitement to the 
heroic saga of me, Zenno Rob Roy...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, what's with you? You're 
completely back to your energetic self.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Rob Roy, huh? Yes... racing against her 
would be—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be that she's having the most 
fun of all?)
